item.description: The White House didn't elaborate on what condition it is treating.

item.title: Recall: Dog treats sold in multiple states may have salmonella
item.description: A Florida-based pet food company is recalling dog treats sold in several states that may be contaminated with salmonella, according to a recent FDA announcement.

item.title: Greene: Trump could use manufactured crisis to cancel midterms
item.description: Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R-Ga.) on Sunday said President Trump could attempt to use a national emergency declaration to cancel midterm elections.

item.title: Video shows Hillary Clinton erupt at GOP over unauthorized Boebert photo during Epstein deposition
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton threatened to walk out of a deposition after Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) shared a picture of her during testimony to the House Oversight Committee for their investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Total lunar eclipse to turn moon blood red: When and how to see it
item.description: With a little cooperation from the clouds, skygazers in the U.S. will get to watch as the moon turns blood red during Tuesday morning's total lunar eclipse.

item.title: DOJ drops defense of Trump orders targeting law firms
item.description: The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Monday deserted its defense of President Trump’s executive orders targeting several of the nation’s top law firms, court filings show.

item.title: US embassy in Riyadh struck by drones, Saudi Arabia says
item.description: The U.S. Embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, was struck by multiple drones on Monday following President Trump’s attacks on Iran.

item.title: Philadelphia rally reflects deep divisions over U.S. strikes in Iran
item.description: PHILADELPHIA (WPHL) -- Dozens of people assembled near the Philadelphia Museum of Art before marching down the Benjamin Franklin Parkway to City Hall on Sunday. Some participants celebrated the U.S. strikes targeting Iran’s leadership, expressing hope that the action could weaken the country’s ruling regime.
